channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Milhares vão às ruas a favor da reeleição de Lula
item.description: Thousands of Lula's supporters took to the streets in several cities to defend his re-election. The demonstrations also protested against the Banco Master scandal involving Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: É importante saber o que diz a Constituição sobre segurança pública, diz Lula em transmissão
item.description: Lula stated in a live broadcast that it is important to know what the Federal Constitution says about public security. The president, running for reelection, highlighted the topic as a priority in his speech.

item.title: Quero que a gente conquiste definitivamente o fim da escala 6x1, diz Lula à militância
item.description: Presidente Lula told party supporters in a Sunday live stream that he wants Brazil to definitively end the 6x1 work shift scale, as part of his reelection campaign push.

item.title: Em live para a militância, Lula chama Flávio de miliciano
item.description: In a livestream aimed at party activists, Lula called Flávio Bolsonaro a militia member and sharpened his rhetoric against his main rival.

item.title: Lula: criaram banqueiro e criaram quadrilha da previdência social; nós prendemos os envolvidos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, seeking re-election, claimed his administration 'created a banker' and dismantled a 'social security gang' from the previous government, while his administration imprisoned those involved. The statement, made on May 13, reinforces his anti-corruption and economic management narrative.

item.title: Lula faz 'live' com apoiadores no Alvorada; em 2022, TSE proibiu Bolsonaro de promover própria campanha no palácio
item.description: Lula held a live with supporters at the Alvorada Palace to promote his reelection bid, using campaign equipment, despite the TSE having prohibited Bolsonaro from doing the same at the palace in 2022. His campaign claims full compliance with TSE regulations, while the president directly criticized opponent Flávio Bolsonaro during the broadcast.

item.title: Arruda promete construir hospital e levar VLT até São Sebastião
item.description: José Roberto Arruda (PSD) campaigned through São Sebastião, promising to build a hospital and bring the VLT to the region via the fourth bridge. He also emphasized saving the Banco de Brasília (BRB) to boost the local economy and defended the legality of his candidacy, urging the popular vote to decide the election.

item.title: Crítica: Lola Young mostra personalidade em seu som sincerão no Palco Mundo
item.description: Lola Young delivered an authentic and charismatic performance at Rock in Rio 2026's Palco Mundo stage, braving rain and sound issues with humor. The 25-year-old British singer, open about her struggles with addiction, won over the Brazilian audience with a diverse setlist spanning pop, blues, and soul, ending the show emotionally.

item.title: Moraes diz a Fachin que Mendonça mantém sob sigilo ‘elementos essenciais’ para julgamento
item.description: Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes asked STF President Edson Fachin to lift the seal on an investigation related to the Master Bank frauds before Tuesday's trial. Fachin took over the rapporteurship of the probe into alleged ties between Moraes and former banker Daniel Vorcaro, replacing André Mendonça, amid a crisis at the STF.

item.title: Justiça manda retirar vídeo de Renan Filho sobre JHC e Banco Master
item.description: The TRE-AL ordered the removal of a Renan Filho video accusing JHC of being investigated in the IPREV/Banco Master case due to lack of evidence. The rapporteur cited an MPF certificate showing 'NADA CONSTA' and TSE precedent on political criticism limits. The race remains tied in polls for Alagoas governor.

item.title: A três semanas do 1º turno, Lula cobra engajamento de apoiadores nas redes
item.description: With 21 days to the first round, Lula urged supporters to engage online and on the streets, framing the election as truth versus lies. He attacked ex-presidents Collor and Bolsonaro, acknowledged campaign distribution errors and said the PT will recentralize material production.

item.title: Nas redes, direita enxerga blindagem de Fachin a Moraes, e esquerda proteção de Mendonça a Flávio
item.description: Social media showed a polarized split over the STF crisis: the right accused Fachin of shielding Moraes and PF, while the left alleged Mendonça protected Flávio Bolsonaro in the Dark Horse case. The PF leadership dispute and Dino's reversal dominated debates, with right-wing accounts producing 54% of posts, left 29% and press 17%.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha sai em defesa de produtora de filme sobre Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, friend of Lulinha, publicly defended film producer Karina Ferreira da Gama, behind the Dark Horse movie about Bolsonaro, amid two Federal Police investigations. Roberta is probed for alleged favors to the Lula administration through her ties to Lulinha, while Karina faces suspicion of misusing public funds and the film's budget through front NGOs.

item.title: Ex-ministros e economistas divulgam carta em apoio a Fachin
item.description: Former ministers and economists, including Pedro Malan, Armínio Fraga, and Miguel Reale Jr., issued an open letter supporting STF President Edson Fachin amid an institutional crisis at the Court. The signatories call for full transparency in the investigation involving Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, and demand structural reforms to strengthen collegiality and impartiality within the STF.

item.title: QG de Flávio Bolsonaro vê ‘febre alta’ na economia antes do que Lula esperava
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro has leveraged the economic crisis to frame his campaign, emphasizing rising prices, household debt, and violence. Lula, conversely, has sought to align business leaders and outline fiscal policies, concerned about market response amid worsening economic conditions.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram os números de Augusto Cury na última semana
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) remained in third place in all four presidential polls last week, but lost ground, dropping from 11% to 9% in BTG/Nexus and from 8% to 6% in Datafolha. In hypothetical second-round matchups, both BTG/Nexus and Datafolha show a technical tie between Cury and Lula at 45% to 43%.

item.title: Fachin pede à PGR manifestação sobre quebra de sigilo pedida por Moraes
item.description: STF President Fachin asked the PGR to comment on Minister Moraes' request to lift the secrecy of Pet 15.645 and access records before judging Pet 16.662, which contains messages between Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. As the case was not among those previously mentioned by the PGR, Fachin ordered the Attorney General to respond promptly. The ruling comes amid an internal Supreme Court crisis over disclosure of documents and investigations involving justices.

item.title: Ex-ministros assinam carta em apoio a Fachin e cobram transparência no STF
item.description: A group of 199 personalities, including former ministers and former bank presidents, signed a letter supporting Edson Fachin and the STF, demanding transparency in the investigations and the plenary session scheduled for September 15, 2026, which will analyze the case of Alexandre de Moraes regarding the Banco Master.

item.title: Zanin determina que PF entregue cópia do celular de Vorcaro a seu gabinete até às 23h de hoje
item.description: STF Minister Cristiano Zanin ordered the Federal Police to deliver a copy of Danilo Vorcaro's phone data to his office by 11pm today. The move aims to secure evidence in an investigation linked to Vorcaro.

item.title: Caiado recebe alta após pneumonia: “Agora vamos para a campanha”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado was discharged from hospital after 3 days treated for pneumonia and said he will continue his campaign at a reduced pace. He confirmed attendance at a MathiasTV debate on Monday, following the cancellation of the consortium debate due to absences by Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Autofaturamento em empresa ligada a Dark Horse chamou atenção da polícia
item.description: São Paulo police obtained search warrants against the Dark Horse producer, linked to Karina da Gama, suspected of diverting R$108 million from a city contract to fund Bolsonaro's biographical film. Irregularities include unsubstantiated billing, canceled invoices, and self-billing of R$1.4 million by the ICB itself.

item.title: Nunes Marques acompanha ações para eleitores indígenas em Roraima
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques visited the Maturuca community in Roraima to oversee initiatives aimed at indigenous voters, including an ombudsman channel, training sessions, and resource donations. The visit took place in a year marking a record number of indigenous candidacies in Brazil, according to Apib.

item.title: Militantes e candidatos do PT saem às ruas neste domingo em dia de 'mobilização nacional' por Lula
item.description: The PT held a national mobilization across several cities, with rallies supporting Lula and the presence of the party's candidates and allies. Leaders such as Benedita da Silva, Fernando Haddad and Geraldo Alckmin emphasized national sovereignty and investigations into the Master case. The campaign saw greater engagement in the Northeast, while events in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro were affected by rain.

item.title: Ex-ministros, economistas e empresários assinam carta em apoio a Fachin
item.description: 198 figures, including ex-ministers from FHC, Lula and Dilma governments, signed a letter supporting Fachin and the STF. The document calls for transparency in investigations and urgent institutional reforms amid the judicial crisis.

item.title: Veja como foi o fim de semana dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: Over the weekend, Lula criticized the STF for selective leaks of investigations and the Banco Master case, while highlighting his government's anti-corruption actions. Augusto Cury walked through São Paulo, criticized 'old politics' and proposed measures for indebted families and youth.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula faz live para falar com apoiadores
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), a reelection candidate, is holding a live event on Sunday (Sep. 13, 2026) to discuss the final stretch of the campaign with supporters. The PT is also organizing banners, car rallies, leafleting and marches across the country, with the participation of First Lady Janja Lula da Silva and party leaders. The first round of elections will be held on October 4.

item.title: O risco Lula 4.0?
item.description: The main institutional risk of a fourth Lula term lies not in the presidency itself, but in the lack of power alternation, potentially weakening the independence of oversight bodies like the Supreme Federal Court. Extended periods without alternation can constitutionally shape the composition of these institutions, reducing their autonomy.

item.title: Grupo em defesa da democracia manifesta apoio a medidas adotadas por Fachin em carta enviada ao STF
item.description: Democracy support group backs Fachin's measures amid STF crisis. Letter signed by 172 figures demands transparency in investigations into alleged chats between Moraes and Vorcaro.

item.title: Zanin manda PF enviar íntegra do celular de Vorcaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin ordered the Federal Police to deliver the full content of Daniel Vorcaro's phone to his office. The measure aims to allow Zanin to analyze the data to form his conviction in the ongoing case.

item.title: Para instalar governabilidade, próximo presidente precisa ter mãos fortes, afirma Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) condemned the crisis at the Supreme Court (STF) and stated that the next president will need "strong hands" to establish stable governance, underscoring the need for authority and institutional control.

item.title: Caiado deixa hospital e diz que é hora de a sociedade eleger quem possa reordenar a democracia
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) was removed from the ventilator and discharged from Vila Nova Star Hospital, stating it is time for society to elect someone who can reorganize democracy. He criticized the crisis at the STF and reinforced his candidacy as an alternative to restore political stability.

item.title: Por que tanto Lula como Flávio Bolsonaro contam com uma indicação a mais ao STF
item.description: The STF crisis impacts the 2026 election, with Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro claiming they have an extra indication for the Court. Lula criticizes Toffoli, while Flávio predicts Moraes' downfall. Both use the Supreme Court to fuel political polarization.

item.title: Papel achado com Karina põe "Mario" como "sócio" de produtora de Dark Horse
item.description: A document seized at Karina Gama's residence names Mário Frias as a partner of Goup USA, the company managing Dark Horse in Brazil, despite no formal role; investigations suggest connections between Frias's budget amendments, payments to the producer, and the film's funding, hinting at an alleged criminal scheme.

item.title: Caso Dark Horse: polícia busca servidores que validaram pagamentos a ONG
item.description: São Paulo police investigate contracts between Instituto Conhecer Brasil and the city hall, probing possible misallocation of parliamentary amendments linked to federal deputy Mário Frias. The municipal secretariat was ordered to provide documents but failed to respond timely, prompting further investigation. Karina Ferreira da Gama, connected to the Dark Horse production company, was targeted in a federal operation.

item.title: Após 4 dias internado por pneumonia, Caiado recebe alta e retoma campanha
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado was discharged from Vila Nova Star Hospital after four days hospitalized for pneumonia. Although not yet fully recovered, he plans to resume campaigning with a lighter schedule, avoiding frequent travel and large gatherings. His hospitalization also served as a platform to propose SUS reforms, including modernized queue management and expanded telemedicine use.

item.title: Durigan rebate Cleitinho: Lula “encarou” dívida de MG com voto do senador
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan countered Senator Cleitinho Azevedo by highlighting that the Lula government already created the Program for Full Payment of State Debts (Propag) to help Minas Gerais manage its $180 billion debt. Durigan also pointed out that Cleitinho voted in favor of Propag in the Senate. Cleitinho had challenged presidential candidates to present proposals to assist the state.

item.title: Sebastião Coelho convoca ato para o dia em que STF decidirá sobre Moraes
item.description: Sebastião Coelho (Novo) called for a protest in front of Congress on the day the STF will review Moraes' decision regarding Vorcaro's messages. The demonstration will be in defense of the Constitution and freedoms, with reinforced policing expected.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram os números de Flávio Bolsonaro na última semana
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) ended the week in his most competitive position in the presidential race, technically tied with Lula (PT) in all second-round polls and ahead in some. This closeness also appears in the first round, where Flávio ranges between 35% and 37.4%, maintaining technical ties with Lula in some cases. BTG/Nexus and AtlasIntel highlight the senator numerically ahead of the president in direct comparison.

item.title: Ana Marcela e Matheus Melecchi levam ouro nos Jogos Sul-Americanos
item.description: Ana Marcela Cunha and Matheus Melecchi won gold in the 10km open water events at the 2026 South American Games in Santa Fe, securing Brazil's spot at the 2027 Pan American Games in Lima. Their strategic approach and strong technique stood out during the competition.

item.title: Produtora de ‘Dark Horse’ não funcionava no endereço informado
item.description: The producer Go Up Entertainment, responsible for the film 'Dark Horse' inspired by Jair Bolsonaro, was not operating at the address provided to authorities. The 'Operation Wi-Fi' investigates suspicions of public fund misuse for the film's production, targeting Karina da Gama's companies and the Instituto Conhecer Brasil. The defense claims the producer collaborates with investigations and committed no wrongdoing.

item.title: Dark Horse: polícia aponta faturas sem lastro de R$ 8,5 milhões de empresa
item.description: São Paulo Civil Police found that Make One Tecnologia Digital, subcontracted by Instituto Conhecer Brasil (ICB), issued invoices without fiscal backing worth R$ 8.5 million. The sequentially numbered invoices, all with the same due date, were investigated in the 'WiFi Livre' operation, which probes possible embezzlement of R$ 108 million from the city hall contract to fund the film 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: Produtora de Dark Horse, alvo de operação da PF, diz sofrer pressão para delatar: 'Não serei novo Mauro Cid'
item.description: Karina Gama, producer of the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro, claims she is pressured to give testimony but denies having any information to incriminate anyone. The Federal Police's 'Operation Make Up' investigates parliamentary amendments misallocation and suspects that part of the R$157 million contract with São Paulo city hall may have been diverted to Go Up Entertainment. She denies irregularities and criticizes political persecution.

item.title: O retrocesso democrático que vem do poder judicial
item.description: The author argues that the Supreme Federal Court has become the most dangerous power in the Republic, capable of undermining democracy through judicial decisions that shape Brazilian political life. The recent scandal shows that 'judicial factions' and 'mob lawyers' are not just metaphors but realities influencing critical decisions in the country.

item.title: Mendonça diz ser contra abrir íntegra do celular de Vorcaro e pede que Fachin apure suposta coação na PF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça stated his opposition to releasing the full contents of former banker Daniel Vorcaro's phone, arguing it could disrupt the upcoming trial. Mendonça also requested that Minister Edson Fachin investigate alleged misconduct within the Federal Police related to the case.

item.title: Líder de movimento anti-STF, Skaf já foi denunciado e auxiliar de Bolsonaro
item.description: Paulo Skaf, president of Fiesp and leader of the anti-Supreme Court movement, was indicted for corruption, money laundering, and electoral fraud in a case dismissed due to irregularities in evidence collection. Despite this, he leads a business initiative pressuring the STF regarding the trial of Alexandre de Moraes, with backing from allies of Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Vorcaro sugeriu usar proximidade com governo Lula como “marketing”
item.description: Messages analyzed by the Federal Police reveal that Daniel Vorcaro treated the Banco Master's proximity to the Lula government as a strategic advantage. In July 2024, following criticism of the bank, Vorcaro compared the relationship with the petista administration to that of the Batista brothers and suggested using this proximity as a marketing tool. The case illustrates discussions about political influence in the financial sector.

item.title: Mendonça e Castro conversaram sobre Cabral um dia após soltura depender só do STF
item.description: Minister André Mendonça and Congressman Cláudio Castro discussed the Sérgio Cabral case one day after his release became dependent solely on a Supreme Court ruling. The conversation took place on September 13, 2026.

item.title: Haddad e Alckmin participam de ato na Paulista com público reduzido
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) attended a campaign event on Paulista Avenue with a reduced audience due to rain, alongside Geraldo Alckmin and Edinho Silva. The candidates advocated for breaking secrecy in the Banco Master case and supported Lula's reelection. The event was part of a national PT mobilization.

item.title: Maria Bethânia declara voto em Lula e Janja compartilha o momento
item.description: Singer Maria Bethânia publicly endorsed President Lula during her performance at the Coala Festival in São Paulo, flashing the 'L' sign and announcing her vote for him in the 2026 elections. First Lady Janja and Lula's official accounts shared the moment on social media. The 80-year-old artist, who has previously supported the PT, closed the festival's first day as one of its main attractions.

item.title: Ministros do STF esperam receber rito da sessão sobre investigação de Moraes na segunda-feira
item.description: STF ministers await the session's rito regarding an investigation into Moraes, with Fachin drafting a script after meetings with colleagues and the prosecutor general. Despite suggestions to postpone after elections, Fachin proceeds, potentially allowing Moraes's defense and a shorter session. The session is expected to be brief to prevent delays.
